preconditions.description: The first line of input contains an integer T representing the number of test cases, where T >= 1.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains an integer N >= 1.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= i for i, x in enumerate(B, start=1)) for B in test_cases_B)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence B contains N integers where each B_i satisfies 1 <= B_i <= i.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'YES') == (all(B[i] == i or any(B[j] == B[i] and j > i for j in range(i+1, N)) for i in range(N))) for line, B in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases_B))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if for every index i (0-based), either B[i] equals i+1 (the initial value) or there exists some index j > i such that B[j] equals B[i]. This captures the condition that any value reduced from its initial state must have been 'copied' from a later position that also holds that value, ensuring the GCD operation logic is consistent with the constraint B_k <= k.
